evals.prompt: I want to learn how binary search works well enough to explain it. Use the folder /tmp/study-binary-search and start.
expectations: The folder is initialized through workspace.init with the learner's goal and a depth of explain.
The learner is asked which kind of session to start (learning, practice or review) before any session or question is created.
No answer, confidence, thinking or session choice is written on the learner's behalf.

evals.prompt: Teach me binary search so I can explain it; keep my progress in /tmp/study-binary-search-2. Start a learning session now, I have no materials.
expectations: workspace.init and session.start are both recorded; session.start carries the learner's own words.
Exactly one diagnostic question is saved with question.pose before it is shown, with no lessonText.
The turn ends waiting for the learner's answer instead of answering or continuing on their behalf.

evals.prompt: Quick question: what is the time complexity of binary search?
expectations: The question is answered directly without creating or writing a learning folder.
